notice: Frontstage decision labels only. Operational research remains in the existing backstage data files.

long-term.label: Long-term SMS / OTP
long-term.description: Real mobile numbers you can keep for account verification and recovery.

data.label: Data SIM / eSIM
data.description: Travel and longer-term data routes, separated from real SMS-capable numbers.

temporary.label: Temporary SMS
temporary.description: One-time or rented SMS routes for short-lived verification jobs.

giffgaff-uk.caveat: Cheap to keep, but recent overseas-number recycling complaints make continuity worth watching.

lebara-uk.caveat: Low keep-alive cost, but the line must be activated in the UK first.

tello-us.caveat: Strong overseas continuity after activation, but first activation requires a US cellular connection.

ultra-paygo-us.caveat: $3/30-day service is cheap; initial acquisition/activation path matters.

h2o-paygo-us.caveat: Cheap PAYG retention, but current overseas SMS continuity is not a strong point.

a1-croatia-prepaid-esim.caveat: Remote eSIM activation and China roaming SMS are recently reproduced; the current online top-up minimum is €5, while the keep-alive interval is still community-derived.

mobal-japan-voice-data.caveat: A real Japanese mobile number with a higher recurring cost than keep-alive-focused routes.

sakura-japan-voice-data.caveat: The low suspension fee preserves the number only; active SMS requires normal service.

china-official-carrier.caveat: Useful when a mainland-China number is specifically required; carrier/plan behavior varies.

airalo-data.caveat: Use for data. Do not treat a data-only eSIM as a verification phone number.

trip-cmlink-china-data.caveat: Cheap mainland-China data route with mixed performance: recent users report 4G-only periods, evening slowdowns and device variation. Treat the 5G label as best-effort, not guaranteed.

mobal-japan-data-physical.caveat: Useful physical-SIM fallback for Japan when eSIM is not suitable.

cmlink-52-country-365d.caveat: Long-duration backup data with recent first-hand use; this exact seller SKU is data-only and non-top-up/reinstall, and CMLink reliability reports vary by plan, so test before relying on it.

local-data-physical.caveat: Fallback category only; choose a concrete local product before buying.

smspool-temp.caveat: A paid order is still not long-term ownership of the number.

5sim-temp.caveat: Useful for one-time jobs; do not build account recovery around ordinary activation orders.

activatex-temp.caveat: Comparison layer: the downstream supplier determines privacy, refund and number reuse.
